adCopy.title: The GLP-1 Side Effect No One Mentions
adCopy.body:
What did they NOT tell you when they prescribed your GLP-1?

They told you about the nausea.
The injection schedule.
The dietary changes.

But nobody mentioned what's happening to your drive.

Here's the gap:

GLP-1 meds trigger rapid weight loss. Your body doesn't care whether it burns fat or lean tissue when it's shedding that fast.

You're losing the exact tissue that keeps your metabolism steady — and your hormone pathways healthy.

So the number on the scale drops.

But so does the thing behind your energy. Your focus. Your stamina. Your presence in every room that matters.

There's a reason you feel lighter but not better.

Dr. Adam Reese has seen this pattern hundreds of times. An MD who built Tenor specifically for the gap between "your labs are normal" and "I don't feel like myself anymore."

His recommendation for every man currently on a GLP-1:

A daily protocol. Two capsules every morning. 21 active ingredients at disclosed doses — supporting what rapid weight loss quietly drains.

💪 Tongkat Ali (400mg) — supports the stress response and healthy hormone pathways during rapid weight loss

💪 Zinc (50mg) — feeds the system your body relies on for testosterone metabolism

💪 Maca (250mg) + L-Arginine (250mg) — supports energy, circulation, and drive from two angles

No proprietary blends. Third-party tested. cGMP US facility.

In a survey of 1,203 men: 94% reported sustained morning energy. 81% noticed improved endurance. 87% felt more focused and present.

Get your 30-day supply for $44 at 52% off. 90-day guarantee.

Read Dr. Reese's protocol for what GLP-1s are quietly doing to men's drive — and the daily support he recommends.

adCopy.title: Stop Losing Drive. Start Today.
adCopy.body:
Your energy is dropping right now.

And it's not "just getting older."

Every month you put off doing something about it, three systems keep declining together:

Your stress response stays elevated — draining the signal that keeps you sharp.

The pathway your body uses to produce drive gets quieter.

And circulation — the thing behind stamina, recovery, and presence — slows down.

That brain fog at 2 p.m.?

The gut that won't budge no matter what you eat?

The fact that you'd rather scroll your phone than do anything with your evening?

That's not laziness.

That's a system problem. And it compounds the longer you wait.

Tenor Daily Drive Essentials was built to support all three systems at once:

💪 Tongkat Ali (400mg) — supports healthy hormone pathways and stress response

💪 Zinc (50mg) — feeds the system your body relies on for daily drive

💪 L-Arginine (250mg) — supports nitric oxide and healthy circulation

And 21 total active ingredients working across three pathways — supporting what your body makes, keeping what you've got, and protecting the systems that produce it.

In a survey of 1,203 men: 94% reported sustained morning energy. 87% felt more focused and present. Not a vague "maybe." Real, steady energy.

Get your 30-day supply for $44 at 52% off and receive a $35 Welcome Kit value. Every order is backed by a 90-day guarantee.

If you don't feel the difference, you get every cent back.

But here's the thing — your drive isn't going to support itself while you "think about it."

adCopy.title: The GLP-1 Side Effect No One Mentions
adCopy.body:
What did they NOT tell you when they prescribed your GLP-1?

They told you about the nausea.
The injection schedule.
The dietary changes.

But nobody mentioned what's happening to your drive.

Here's the gap:

GLP-1 meds trigger rapid weight loss. Your body doesn't care whether it burns fat or lean tissue when it's shedding that fast.

You're losing the exact tissue that keeps your metabolism steady — and your hormone pathways healthy.

So the number on the scale drops.

But so does the thing behind your energy. Your focus. Your stamina. Your presence in every room that matters.

There's a reason you feel lighter but not better.

Dr. Adam Reese has seen this pattern hundreds of times. An MD who built Tenor specifically for the gap between "your labs are normal" and "I don't feel like myself anymore."

His recommendation for every man currently on a GLP-1:

A daily protocol. Two capsules every morning. 21 active ingredients at disclosed doses — supporting what rapid weight loss quietly drains.

💪 Tongkat Ali (400mg) — supports the stress response and healthy hormone pathways during rapid weight loss

💪 Zinc (50mg) — feeds the system your body relies on for testosterone metabolism

💪 Maca (250mg) + L-Arginine (250mg) — supports energy, circulation, and drive from two angles

No proprietary blends. Third-party tested. cGMP US facility.

In a survey of 1,203 men: 94% reported sustained morning energy. 81% noticed improved endurance. 87% felt more focused and present.

Get your 30-day supply for $44 at 52% off. 90-day guarantee.

Read Dr. Reese's protocol for what GLP-1s are quietly doing to men's drive — and the daily support he recommends.

adCopy.title: What GLP-1 Does to Your Drive
adCopy.body:
The weight's coming off.

But something else is going with it.

GLP-1 meds work. Nobody's arguing that.

But here's what your prescribing doctor didn't mention:

Rapid weight loss floods your system with cortisol.

Cortisol chokes the signal that keeps your energy steady. Your body burns lean tissue for fuel — instead of protecting it.

Your mornings get heavier.
Your afternoons disappear.
Your presence fades.

You're lighter on the scale — but foggier, flatter, and running on fumes.

That's not progress. That's a trade you didn't agree to.

Tenor Daily Drive Essentials was built to support what GLP-1s quietly drain:

💪 Tongkat Ali (400mg) — supports the stress response that rapid weight loss disrupts

💪 Zinc (50mg) — feeds the pathway your body needs to maintain healthy hormone levels

💪 21 active ingredients at disclosed doses — supporting drive, stamina, and recovery from every angle

No proprietary blends.
No hidden doses.
No guessing.

In a survey of 1,203 men, 94% reported sustained morning energy. 87% felt more focused and present. Results you can feel — backed by transparent dosing, not promises.

Get your 30-day supply for $44 at 52% off. 90-day guarantee.

See why men on GLP-1s are adding this two-capsule morning protocol to their daily routine.
